title: Bengaluru Metro Pink Line's first 7.5 km (elevated, along Bannerghatta Road, Kalena Agrahara to Tavarekere; 6 stations: Kalena Agrahara, Hulimavu, IIMB, JP Nagar 4th Phase, Jayadeva Hospital, Tavarekere) opens to passengers 6 am Sat 14 Nov 2026 per Karnataka minister Krishna Byre Gowda; PM Modi scheduled to inaugurate Fri 13 Nov; 4 trains + 1 standby, ~8 min at peak hours, gap may shorten as ridership grows (reports); fares not announced by BMRCL; Yellow Line interchange at Jayadeva Hospital; cost about ₹3,470 crore (PTI, ANI); network 96.1 km to about 103.6 km; 12 underground stations to Nagawara still under construction
